temperature_2m.verdict: Air temperature at 2 m increased by about 0.50 °C per decade (1981–2025). This trend is statistically significant (p < 0.001): it is very unlikely to be just chance.

precipitation.verdict: Precipitation decreased by about 0.10 mm/day per decade (1981–2025). This trend is statistically significant (p = 0.010): it is unlikely to be just chance.

relative_humidity_2m.verdict: Relative humidity at 2 m decreased by about 1.8 % per decade (1981–2025). This trend is statistically significant (p = 0.023): it is unlikely to be just chance.

specific_humidity_2m.verdict: For specific humidity at 2 m, the estimated change is −0.011 g/kg per decade (1981–2025), but we cannot rule out chance (p = 0.89). A longer period or a different region might reveal a clear trend.

wind_speed_10m.verdict: Wind speed at 10 m increased by about 0.043 m/s per decade (1981–2025). This trend is statistically significant (p = 0.016): it is unlikely to be just chance.

solar_radiation.verdict: Solar radiation at the surface increased by about 0.060 kWh/m²/day per decade (1984–2025). This trend is statistically significant (p < 0.001): it is very unlikely to be just chance.

evapotranspiration.verdict: Evapotranspiration decreased by about 0.10 mm/day per decade (1981–2025). This trend is statistically significant (p = 0.034): it is unlikely to be just chance.

soil_wetness_root.verdict: Root zone soil wetness decreased by about 0.011 fraction 0–1 per decade (1981–2025). This trend is statistically significant (p = 0.044): it is unlikely to be just chance.
